_comment: Copy into input/<video>/ as video.json. This is the whole edit: git tracks it, the materials beside it are ignored. Paths are relative to this directory. Run: uv run build.py <video> [lang] from the project root.
_shots: (source in-point, duration) per shot. Total near the reference's, cut rhythm close to what measure.py reported. Shared by every language — only the copy changes. Slides: (image filename, duration) per shot, or omit `shots` for every still in src, 3s each.
_copy: Panel copy per language. Keys follow the template's panel kind: offer -> pill, head, cta, url. list -> headline, badge, label, points, cta. `head` is one centred line, two-tone: [[text, colour key], ...].
_sync: Optional. Put cuts and moves on the bed's beat. snap: beat | bar | null (cuts move to the next grid point, min_shot apart). kenburns: drift | beat. pulse: null | flash | zoom. Omit the key and nothing is analysed.
_captions: (line 1, line 2) per shot, per language. Must be the same length as shots — the build refuses otherwise.
